title: 第二章  海之圣战（下）（求收藏，推荐票）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当天晚上，叶落独自站在天穹殿的最高处，

“为什么让我去域外战场，你应该知道我不适合防御这种事？”一旁龙影缓缓出现，

“我，我是为了不让人类的希望断送”

“呵呵”，龙影冷笑，“你是为了让我保护穆萱吧，你以为我不知道你把穆萱封印在了那个地方，还有你应该对这次泄漏的人有所推测吧，到底是谁？”

“是谁已经不重要了，陆长生说得对，那个空间门还有四天就要完全开放，到时候人类所面临的，就将是灭顶之灾，等这次过去再说吧，我不想在大战来临前再让局势动荡一次，你让我一个人静静。”叶落有些无奈。

龙影看了他一眼，没有说什么，直到身影看不见时，声音才飘了过来，“你放心，穆萱我会看好的，至于你，你给我好好活着。”

叶落深深望了龙影一眼，吐了口气，从口袋中拿出来一张照片，照片上是一个男生和一个女生的合照，“穆萱，你放心，哪怕是死，我也会守护好这个有你的世界。”

第二日，数百道恐怖的气息伫立在天穹之殿前，

“昨日我点到名的震世级强者全部跟我走，龙影，给我守好星辰之阵。”

空间扭曲，众人皆是消失在了原地。

——乐痕星外围

一道巨大的结界包裹着整个星球，“符文阵基，你竟然把这个搬过来了，怪不得你要让龙影过去。”

“进去吧，这个结界是只进不出的，除非从外面撤去阵基，否则”叶落没有说下去，他们也能明白。

说罢，叶落率先进了空间门，

“好压抑的感觉，为什么这里的天空是红色的”

“亚伦，小心点，你不觉得这里有些诡异吗，为什么外围几乎一只异兽都没有，我还感觉到自己的灵力有些躁动”

众人都有这些感觉，其实到异域作战是相当不利的，不仅仅是因为这里是异域的主场，更为重要是，这里是无法补充灵力的，因为异域只存在原力，这是一种与灵力完全相反的能量。

“小心！”一抹红光急速朝着亚伦飞去，

“慌什么”一面水盾在亚伦面前张开，众人并没有太担心，虽然那道红光有些诡异，但毕竟亚伦也是接近三百万战力的S级双系异能者，

“咔擦”

“什么！”

“大黑暗天”那枚水盾竟然是瞬间碎裂，而那抹红光竟未有丝毫减弱，亚伦施展大黑暗天才将其消磨殆尽。

“这是什么鬼东西，竟如此强横！”

”海皇结界！“

Page (1/3)

That night, Ye Luo stood alone at the highest point of the Sky Palace,

"Why are you asking me to go to the battlefield outside the territory? You should know that I am not suitable for defense?" A dragon shadow appeared slowly on the side,

"I, I am here to prevent the hope of humanity from being ruined."

"Haha", Long Ying sneered, "You want me to protect Muxuan, you think I don't know where you sealed Muxuan, and you should have some guesses about the person who leaked this time, who is it?"

"It doesn't matter who it is anymore. Lu Changsheng is right. The space gate will be fully opened in four days. At that time, mankind will face a catastrophe. Let's wait until this time passes. I don't want to turmoil the situation again before the war comes. Please leave me alone." Ye Luo was a little helpless.

Long Ying glanced at him and didn't say anything. It wasn't until the figure was out of sight that his voice floated over, "Don't worry, I will take good care of Mu Xuan. As for you, just live a good life for me."

Ye Luo took a deep look at Long Ying, exhaled, and took out a photo from his pocket. The photo was a photo of a boy and a girl. "Mu Xuan, don't worry, even if I die, I will protect this world with you."

On the second day, hundreds of terrifying auras stood in front of the Palace of Heaven,

"All the world-shattering powerhouses that I named yesterday are coming with me, Long Ying, guard the formation of stars for me."

The space was distorted and everyone disappeared in place.

——Outskirts of Lehen Star

A huge barrier wrapped around the entire planet, "Rune formation base, you actually moved this here, no wonder you let Long Ying pass."

"Go in, this barrier cannot be entered or exited, unless the formation base is removed from the outside, otherwise" Ye Luo did not continue, and they could understand.

Having said that, Ye Luo took the lead and entered the space gate first.

"It feels so depressing. Why is the sky here red?"

"Aaron, be careful. Don't you think it's a little weird here? Why is there almost no strange beast outside? I also feel that my spiritual power is a little restless."

Everyone has these feelings. In fact, it is quite disadvantageous to fight in a foreign land, not only because this is the home field of the foreign land, but more importantly, spiritual power cannot be replenished here, because only the original force exists in the foreign land, which is an energy completely opposite to spiritual power.

"Be careful!" A flash of red light flew towards Aaron quickly,

"Why are you panicking?" A water shield opened in front of Aaron, and everyone was not too worried. Although the red light was a bit weird, after all, Aaron was also an S-level dual-type superpower with a combat power of nearly three million.

"Kacha"

"What!"

The water shield of the "Great Dark Sky" shattered instantly, but the red light did not weaken at all. Aaron used the genius of Great Darkness to consume it.

"What the hell is this? It's so tyrannical!"

"Poseidon Barrier!"
